title: Landing party maintenance window
text: The Hawaii-side cable landing party schedules planned maintenance in the first two weeks of each quarter. Avoid quoting hard cutover dates inside that window — confirmed with the local NOC lead after the Q1 2025 outage.

title: Preferred consortium contact for expedited capacity
text: For rush capacity requests on this leg, go direct to the UNITY consortium commercial desk rather than the standard portal — cuts typical turnaround from 10 business days to under 48 hours. Relationship owned by the APAC solutions team.
